roleTitle: I like working close to the problem, the user, and the system.
paragraphs: I'm Pujan Bajracharya, an engineer who works across product design, full-stack development, AI workflows, and operational systems.
I'm strongest in ambiguous environments where the work is not just coding, but understanding the workflow, shaping the solution, building the tool, and improving it with real feedback.

highlights.title: Workflow Discovery
highlights.desc: I map how people actually work before deciding what the system should do.

highlights.title: Product Implementation
highlights.desc: I move from requirements and prototypes into working interfaces, APIs, dashboards, and tools.

highlights.title: AI-Enabled Systems
highlights.desc: I build RAG, agent, OCR, eval, and human-review workflows for messy operational tasks.

highlights.title: Stakeholder Translation
highlights.desc: I turn business, legal, financial, and operational needs into clear technical systems.

callout: The goal is simple: build systems that fit the work, not just the spec.
